verses.text: <pb/>Wanda ake ta tsauta wa a kai a kai, amma ya taurare, ba makawa tasa ta ƙare farat ɗaya.
<pb/>Sa'ad da masu adalci suke mulki, jama'a sukan yi murna, amma sa'ad da mugaye suke mulki, jama'a sukan yi nishi.
<pb/>Wanda yake ƙaunar hikima yana faranta zuciyar mahaifinsa. <pb/>Amma wanda yake abuta da karuwai zai lalatar da dukiyarsa.
<pb/>Sarkin da yake aikata adalci ƙasarsa za ta yi ƙarƙo, amma wanda yake karɓar rashawa zai lalatar da ƙasar.
<pb/>Mutum wanda yake yi wa maƙwabcinsa daɗin baƙi yana kafa wa kansa tarko.
<pb/>Laifin mugun zai zama tarko a gare shi, amma adali zai raira waƙa, ya yi farin ciki.
<pb/>Adali yana sane da hakkin matalauta, amma mugun bai san wannan ba.
<pb/>Ashararai sukan sa wa birni wuta, amma masu hikima sukan kwantar da hasala.
<pb/>Idan gardama ta shiga tsakanin mai hikima da wawa, sai wawa ya yi ta fushi, ko kuwa ya yi ta dariya, gardamar dai ba za ta ƙare ba.
<pb/>Mutane masu kisankai suna ƙin amintaccen mutum, amma adalai za su kiyaye ransa.
<pb/>Wawa yakan nuna fushinsa ko yaushe, amma mutum mai hikima yakan kanne fushinsa.
<pb/>Idan mai mulki yana kasa kunne ga maganganun ƙarya, dukan ma'aikatansa za su zama maƙaryata.
<pb/>Matalauci da azzalumi suna tarayya a abu ɗaya, wato dukansu Ubangiji ne yake ba su ganin gari.
<pb/>Idan sarki yana yi wa talakawa shari'ar gaskiya, zai daɗe yana mulki.
<pb/>Horo da tsautawa suna ba da hikima, amma yaron da aka sangarta zai jawo wa mahaifiyarsa kunya.
<pb/>Sa'ad da mugaye suke mulki, laifofi suka ƙaru, amma adalai za su ga faɗuwar waɗannan mutane.
<pb/>Ka hori ɗanka zai daɗaɗa maka rai, ya kuma faranta maka zuciya.
<pb/>Inda ba a bin faɗar Allah, jama'a za su kangare, amma mai farin ciki ne wanda yake kiyaye dokar Allah.
<pb/>Bara ba ya horuwa ta wurin magana kawai, gama ko da ya fahimta ma, ba zai kula ba.
<pb/>Ka ga mutum mai garajen yin magana? To, gara a sa zuciya ga wawa da a sa zuciya gare shi.
<pb/>Baran da aka shagwaɓa tun yana yaro, a ƙarshe zai ɗauki kansa tankar magājin gida.
<pb/>Mutum mai saurin fushi yakan ta da faɗa, mai zafin rai kuma yakan aikata laifi da yawa.
<pb/>Girmankan mutum zai jawo masa ƙasƙanci, amma za a girmama mai tawali'u.
<pb/>Abokin ɓarawo mugun maƙiyin kansa ne, yana jinsa yana ta rantsuwa, amma ba zai ce kome ba.
<pb/>Jin tsoron mutane tarko ne, amma wanda ya dogara ga Ubangiji za a ɗaukaka shi.
<pb/>Mutane da yawa sukan nemi farin jini daga wurin mai mulki, amma Ubangiji ne yake yi wa mutum adalci.
<pb/>Mutum marar gaskiya abin ƙyama ne ga adali, adali kuma abin ƙyama ne ga mugun.
